top_violation_types.title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined caregiver does not have high school diploma or high school equivalent certificate.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: No cribs were observed in the infant room.

top_violation_types.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was observed positioned in the hallway to monitor two seperate classrooms during naptime.

top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one was behind with immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The cribs at the operation did not have a labeling system that had the child's name, or as an alternative, having a labeling system with a number on the crib and a number/infant assignment map available to match with it in the room.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.059 - Employment Affidavit (26 TAC §HRC42.059 - Employment Affidavit)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not have documentation of the notarized affidavit.
